scenes.narration: Rereading is the most popular study method on earth and one of the worst. Highlighting feels productive and teaches you almost nothing.
Your brain confuses familiarity with knowledge. The page looks known, so you assume you know it. Try writing it from memory and you will find out.
The fix is retrieval. Close the book and force the answer out of your head. The struggle to remember is what builds the pathway.
Spacing beats cramming every time. Reviewing once a day for five days beats five hours in one night, with less total time.
Study less, test yourself more. The method that feels harder is the one that actually works.
